description:
• About our brand and products:

Welcome to Kimono Cat! We specialize in quality handmade casual kimonos, haoris, samurai pants, and unique cultural lifestyle products. Our designs seamlessly blend traditional aesthetics with contemporary streetwear, making them perfect for festivals, anime conventions, and everyday stylish comfort.

• What makes us different:

Every piece at Kimono Cat is crafted with meticulous attention to detail, using comfortable 100%cotton. We have a highly passionate and loyal community, and our products are proven crowd-pleasers at major cultural events and online stores alike.

• How affiliates can earn:

By joining our team, you earn a generous 10% commission on every successful sale generated through your unique referral link or custom coupon code. We also offer a 30-day cookie window, meaning you still get credited for the sale even if your audience decides to purchase up to a month after clicking your link!

• How to promote us:

It’s easy! You can share your love for Kimono Cat by creating stylish try-on hauls, festival outfit ideas, unboxing videos, or lifestyle photos on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. Simply add your affiliate link or coupon code to your bio, captions, or video descriptions to start earning.

• Other information:

Payouts are processed monthly with a standard 30-day holding period to verify orders. If you love unique fashion and high-quality streetwear, we would love to grow together with you!
payout_period: Monthly payouts on the 10th of each month (with a 30-day holding period for order verification).
